chains.name: Heart's Desire
chains.description: When Eve is on the field, all allied summoned creatures' damage dealt is increased by 20%.

chains.name: Perfect Gathering
chains.description: [Family Workshop] can now stack 4 more times, while each summoned creature of Eve provides 1 more stack of [Family Workshop].

chains.name: Old Memories
chains.description: Each stack of [Family Workshop] additionally increases the Max HP of allied summoned creatures by 2%.

buffs.description:
Haunted Blessing: Eve summons [Raging Bear] at the target location.

Curio: Only available while [Raging Bear]/[Cuckoo Clock] is active. Eve replaces one with another toy. The new toy inherits the replaced toy's HP percentage.

[Raging Bear] Inherits 120% of Eve's Max HP, 80% of her Attack, and 240% of her Defense and Magic Resistance. It can block 2 enemies, and each of its normal attacks deals (Bear's Attack *?%) Physical Damage.

[Cuckoo Clock] Inherits 60% of Eve's Max HP, 100% of her Attack, and 100% of her Defense and Magic Resistance. It can block 1 enemy, and each of its normal attacks deals (Clock's Attack *?%) Magic Damage to all enemies within a 3x3 square.

After the battle starts, Eve will summon a [Scare Box] on a grid close by where her allies can enter. 10 seconds after the [Scare Box] dies, Eve will summon a new one.

[Scare Box] Inherits 100% of Eve's Max HP and 100% of her Defense and Magic Resistance. It can block 1 enemy. For every 600 Max HP [Scare Box] has, the damage taken by all enemies within range increases by ?%. Also, it briefly inflicts Fear on all enemies within range every 8 seconds.
While Eve is on the field, for each allied summoned creature present, all allied summoned creatures gain ?% Attack bonus and ?% Attack Speed bonus, stacking up to 8 times.
